categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction and migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration failure and an unhandled std::bad_function_call exception when migrating legacy watch-only wallets with no private keys (issue #36483). Migration correctness is explicitly prioritized in the wallet rubric as an essential path every remaining legacy user must cross.
